headline: Watches under $1,000 with official prices
stop_reason: Not enough distinct, trusted items for an 8-slide listicle. Verified under-$1,000 library items with brand or authorized-retailer prices give only 4 collections: Hamilton Khaki Field H69401140 ($495, hamiltonwatch.com, 2026-11-21), Hamilton Jazzmaster Viewmatic H32515641 ($945, hamiltonwatch.com, 2026-11-21), Tissot PRX T1374071105101 ($850, watchesofswitzerland.com, 2026-11-24), Tissot Seastar T1204071104103 ($925, watchesofswitzerland.com, 2026-11-21). The G-Shock GMC2500-1A8 ($280) and GAC-2500-3A ($145) prices come only from a reseller (Teddy Baldassarre), so they were dropped. The Seiko SPB121 and SRPL15/SRPL13 prices come from Exquisite Timepieces, which is not confirmed as an authorized retailer, so they were dropped. Seiko 5 Sports, Citizen and Orient searches found no official per-model prices, and the official Casio, Seiko and Tissot pages failed to load (403, 404, 410). Tissot Gentleman Powermatic 80 ($795 on tissotwatches.com via search snippet) was not confirmed on a fetched page. Next step: a human or a later run should add 4 more distinct collections with fetched official prices and photos, then re-run this backup.
